title: 'Sound, light and frequency' turns up in a CERN God-particle white paper

tellings.quote: that I got a hit on that exact phrase in that order was in 2012, about 15 years, in a white paper for the discovery of the God particle.

plain: A guest named Brent Friedman, speaking on a podcast about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, says he once searched for the exact phrase 'sound, light and frequency' and got a match in 2012, roughly 15 years after he first came across it. He says it turned up in a white paper from CERN, the big European physics laboratory, about turning the discovery of the 'God particle', a nickname for the Higgs boson, into sound. He tells it as a striking coincidence that hints the phrase meant more than it seemed.
